summary.zh: 由太阳能和超级电容驱动、仅用一个电机同时完成驱动与凸轮转向的创新小车。
summary.en: An innovative vehicle powered by solar energy and supercapacitors, using a single motor for propulsion and cam-based steering.

challenge.zh: 在只有一个驱动电机的约束下，小车需要沿指定路线稳定行驶。凸轮轮廓误差、加工偏差与机构装配误差会共同影响路径精度。
challenge.en: With only one drive motor, the vehicle had to follow a prescribed path. Cam profile, manufacturing and assembly errors all affected trajectory accuracy.

zh: 采用凸轮摆杆机构实现机械转向，将目标路径转化为凸轮轮廓。
基于物理几何启发的迭代方法推导凸轮优化与路径误差模拟程序。
通过误差抵消思路优化关键半径，并设计太阳能板与超级电容充放电电路。
en: Used a cam-rocker mechanism for steering and converted the target route into a cam profile.
Derived a physics- and geometry-inspired iterative method for cam optimization and path-error simulation.
Applied error compensation to key radii and designed solar-panel and supercapacitor charge/discharge electronics.

zh: 建立小车数学模型并编写凸轮优化、路径模拟代码。
完成关键参数的容差分析与多轮优化对比。
设计并焊接超级电容充电电路板，编写打卡亮灯程序。
en: Built the mathematical model and implemented cam optimization and trajectory simulation.
Performed tolerance analysis and compared successive optimization rounds.
Designed and soldered the supercapacitor charging board and programmed checkpoint indicators.

outcome.zh: 完成国家级大学生创新训练项目的整车、仿真软件与电路开发，并形成公开发表论文相关成果。
outcome.en: Completed the vehicle, simulation software and electronics for a National Undergraduate Innovation Training Program, with related work published in a journal paper.
